gentle.title: Anchor one meal with protein
gentle.detail: Eggs, beans, fish, yogurt — pick one and let it lead a meal today. Eating slows down nicely with it.

coach.title: One protein-anchored meal today
coach.detail: Build a meal around a protein source. Fullness lasts longer; afternoon snack-pull eases.

firm_direct.title: Protein. One meal. Today.
firm_direct.detail: Pick a meal. Center it on a protein. Eggs, fish, beans, yogurt. No skipping.

gentle.title: A side of vegetables somewhere today
gentle.detail: Add a vegetable or fruit alongside one meal. The colors do the work.

coach.title: Add veg or fruit to one meal
coach.detail: Toss a side of greens or a piece of fruit onto one meal. Fiber smooths digestion.

firm_direct.title: Veg side. One meal.
firm_direct.detail: Add greens or fruit to one meal. Fresh, frozen — doesn't matter. Add it.

gentle.title: Water alongside the protein meal
gentle.detail: When you sit down to a protein-rich meal, pour a glass of water. Sip while you eat.

coach.title: Water + protein at one meal
coach.detail: Pair a full glass of water with the protein-anchored meal. Helps satiety register.

firm_direct.title: Water + protein. Together.
firm_direct.detail: Protein meal: full glass of water on the table. Drink it. No soda swap.

gentle.title: Let veggies cover half a plate
gentle.detail: When you serve a plate today, give roughly half of it to vegetables. The rest, anything goes.

coach.title: Half-plate vegetables at one meal
coach.detail: Plate up so vegetables take roughly half the surface. Carbs and protein share the rest.

firm_direct.title: Half plate. Veg.
firm_direct.detail: One meal: vegetables fill half the plate. Eyeball it. Plate up. Eat.

gentle.title: Pass on a second serving today
gentle.detail: If you finish a plate and the urge for more comes, wait a few minutes. Often the want softens.

coach.title: Skip seconds at one meal
coach.detail: Finish your first plate, pause for ten minutes before deciding on more. Hunger usually settles.

firm_direct.title: First plate. Pause ten.
firm_direct.detail: First plate done. Wait ten minutes. Decide if you're actually still hungry.

gentle.title: Use a smaller plate at one meal
gentle.detail: Reach for the salad plate instead of the dinner plate today. Same food, different frame.

coach.title: Smaller plate at one meal today
coach.detail: Pick a smaller plate for one meal. Visual portion cues are real — the eyes calibrate fullness.

firm_direct.title: Smaller plate. One meal.
firm_direct.detail: Salad plate, not dinner plate. Serve normal. Eat. Done.

gentle.title: Refill a water bottle once today
gentle.detail: Fill it once, drink it down. The body settles into hydration with little nudges like this.

coach.title: Drink one full water bottle today
coach.detail: Empty a full water bottle over the course of the day. Mid-afternoon energy reads better when you do.

firm_direct.title: One bottle. Empty.
firm_direct.detail: Fill a water bottle. Drink it down before evening. Refill if you can.

gentle.title: Water at every meal today
gentle.detail: Each time you sit to eat, pour a glass of water first. Slow sips between bites.

coach.title: Glass of water with each meal
coach.detail: Three meals, three glasses of water — each one before or alongside. Steady hydration, no spike.

firm_direct.title: Water. Every meal.
firm_direct.detail: Three meals. Three full glasses of water. Pour first, eat second.

gentle.title: A glass of water on waking
gentle.detail: Before coffee, before anything, a glass of water. The body wakes up a little kinder for it.

coach.title: First-thing glass of water
coach.detail: First action on waking: a full glass of water. Rehydrates after the overnight fast.

firm_direct.title: Wake. Drink water.
firm_direct.detail: Out of bed, glass of water before anything. No coffee yet. Water first.

gentle.title: A whole-food snack today
gentle.detail: Fruit, nuts, hard-boiled egg, yogurt — pick one for a snack. Foods you'd recognize as themselves.

coach.title: Whole-food snack today
coach.detail: Snack on something with one ingredient: an apple, a handful of nuts, a hard-boiled egg. Steadier energy follows.

firm_direct.title: One snack. Whole food.
firm_direct.detail: Apple. Nuts. Egg. Yogurt. One snack from the list. No bag with twelve ingredients.

gentle.title: Pass on a packaged snack today
gentle.detail: If a chip-bag moment hits, try a glass of water and ten minutes first. Often the want passes by.

coach.title: Skip one packaged snack today
coach.detail: Notice when you'd reach for a packaged snack — water and a brief pause first. Often you're past it.

firm_direct.title: Skip one packaged snack.
firm_direct.detail: When the bag-craving hits: water, walk away, ten minutes. Don't open it. Move on.

gentle.title: Reach for fresh produce once today
gentle.detail: If a meal could use fresh, choose fresh. Doesn't have to be every meal — just once.

coach.title: Pick fresh produce for one meal
coach.detail: Choose fresh fruit or veg over a frozen-prepared version once today. Texture and flavor land different.

firm_direct.title: Fresh produce. Once.
firm_direct.detail: One meal today: fresh, not frozen-meal. Apple, salad, tomato — anything fresh. Use it.

gentle.title: A no-alcohol evening tonight
gentle.detail: Tea, sparkling water, something kind. Tonight, no glass. Sleep usually thanks you.

coach.title: Alcohol-free evening tonight
coach.detail: Skip the evening drink. Sleep deepens, morning shows up cleaner. Replace with sparkling water if needed.

firm_direct.title: No alcohol tonight.
firm_direct.detail: Tonight: zero. Sparkling water in the wine glass. One evening. Done.

gentle.title: No caffeine after early afternoon
gentle.detail: Try a 2pm cutoff today. Tea, water, decaf after. Sleep onset gets noticeably softer.

coach.title: Caffeine cutoff at 2pm today
coach.detail: Last caffeinated drink before 2pm. Half-life is long; the 2pm cup still touches midnight sleep.

firm_direct.title: Caffeine off. 2pm.
firm_direct.detail: Last cup before 2pm. After that: water, herbal tea, decaf. No exceptions.

gentle.title: A smaller pour tonight
gentle.detail: If you'll have one tonight, pour a little less. Same ritual, gentler dose.

coach.title: Smaller pour tonight
coach.detail: Pour less than usual — a few ounces in, not the full glass. Sleep architecture shifts back.

firm_direct.title: Smaller pour. Tonight.
firm_direct.detail: Less than your usual. Half-glass, not a full pour. One drink, smaller.

gentle.title: Dinner a little earlier today
gentle.detail: If dinner usually lands late, try a half-hour earlier. The body settles for sleep more easily.

coach.title: Eat dinner earlier today
coach.detail: Move dinner up by 30 minutes. Digestion gets a head start before bed; sleep onset comes cleaner.

firm_direct.title: Dinner earlier. 30 min.
firm_direct.detail: Eat dinner half an hour before usual. Plan it now. Done.

gentle.title: Try to be done eating by 8pm
gentle.detail: Last bite by eight. The night runs gentler when the kitchen closes early.

coach.title: Last bite before 8pm tonight
coach.detail: Aim to be done eating by 8pm. Two-hour window before bed lets the body shift to rest.

firm_direct.title: Stop eating. 8pm.
firm_direct.detail: Kitchen closes at 8pm. No exceptions. Water and tea after.

gentle.title: Breakfast within an hour of waking
gentle.detail: Even something small — a piece of fruit, a yogurt — within the first hour. The day starts kinder.

coach.title: Eat within an hour of waking
coach.detail: Get something in within 60 minutes of getting up. Stabilizes blood sugar for the morning.

firm_direct.title: Eat. First hour.
firm_direct.detail: Out of bed, food in within 60 minutes. Yogurt, fruit, eggs. Fuel up.

gentle.title: Reach for the whole-grain version
gentle.detail: Bread, pasta, rice — pick the whole-grain one today. The taste grows on you.

coach.title: Whole-grain swap once today
coach.detail: Choose whole-grain over refined for one item: bread, rice, pasta. Slower energy curve, longer satiety.

firm_direct.title: Whole grain. One swap.
firm_direct.detail: Whole-grain bread. Brown rice. Whole-wheat pasta. One swap. Done.

gentle.title: A deeply-colored fruit today
gentle.detail: Berries, plums, oranges, mango — something bright. The brighter, the more the body notices.

coach.title: One deeply-colored fruit today
coach.detail: Pick a fruit with deep color: berries, plums, mango, oranges. Color tracks with antioxidant content.

firm_direct.title: Bright fruit. Today.
firm_direct.detail: Berries. Plums. Mango. One serving. The brighter, the better.

gentle.title: Cook with olive oil today
gentle.detail: Where you'd use butter or vegetable oil, try olive instead. The flavor leans Mediterranean.

coach.title: Olive oil for one cook today
coach.detail: Use olive oil where you'd default to butter or seed oil. Mediterranean-leaning flavor, fewer saturated fats.

firm_direct.title: Olive oil. One cook.
firm_direct.detail: Pan, olive oil, food. Skip the butter today. Cook normally.

gentle.title: One meal, no screens
gentle.detail: Phone away, TV off, laptop closed for one sitting. The food tastes more like itself.

coach.title: One screen-free meal today
coach.detail: Eat one meal with no screens around. You notice fullness signals you'd otherwise scroll past.

firm_direct.title: Meal. No screens.
firm_direct.detail: Phone face-down. TV off. One full meal. Eyes on food.

gentle.title: Chew slowly at one meal today
gentle.detail: Set the fork down between bites. Notice the chewing. The meal stretches and the body settles.

coach.title: Slow chewing at one meal
coach.detail: Put the fork down between bites at one meal. Fullness lands earlier when chewing isn't rushed.

firm_direct.title: Chew slow. One meal.
firm_direct.detail: Fork down between bites. Chew. Swallow. Pick up. One meal that pace.

gentle.title: Notice the first three bites
gentle.detail: At one meal, let the first three bites have your attention. Texture, temperature, taste. Then carry on.

coach.title: Pay attention to the first three bites
coach.detail: First three bites of one meal: full attention. Real attention recalibrates how the rest of the meal feels.

firm_direct.title: First three bites. Attention.
firm_direct.detail: Bite one. Bite two. Bite three. Full focus. Then eat normally.

gentle.title: Water instead of soda once today
gentle.detail: If a soda moment shows up, swap it for sparkling water with lemon. Same fizz, different load.

coach.title: One soda swap to water today
coach.detail: When you'd reach for soda, choose sparkling water or plain water with lemon. Cuts the sugar pulse.

firm_direct.title: Water. Not soda.
firm_direct.detail: Soda craving: sparkling water. Lemon if needed. No swap-back.

gentle.title: Fruit when something sweet is wanted
gentle.detail: When the sweet pull comes today, try fruit first. Often it's enough.

coach.title: Fruit instead of dessert today
coach.detail: When a sweet craving lands, reach for fruit before the sugar option. Berries, mango, an orange — usually enough.

firm_direct.title: Fruit. Not dessert.
firm_direct.detail: Dessert moment: bowl of fruit. Eat it slowly. Move on to the next thing.

gentle.title: Tea instead of one coffee today
gentle.detail: Swap one coffee for tea — green, black, herbal. The afternoon wave of jitters eases.

coach.title: One coffee swapped for tea
coach.detail: Replace one coffee with tea — green or black has caffeine, herbal has none. Smoother all-day energy.

firm_direct.title: Tea. Not coffee. Once.
firm_direct.detail: One cup today: tea, not coffee. Brew it. Drink it. Stop after.

gentle.title: Prep one ingredient ahead
gentle.detail: Wash some fruit, dice an onion, cook a pot of grains. One thing ready makes tomorrow's meal closer.

coach.title: Prep one ingredient for tomorrow
coach.detail: Wash fruit, dice an onion, cook a grain. One ingredient ahead lowers tomorrow's friction by a lot.

firm_direct.title: Prep. One ingredient.
firm_direct.detail: Wash. Chop. Cook. One thing ready for tomorrow. Container in the fridge.

gentle.title: Cut some vegetables ahead today
gentle.detail: Carrots, peppers, celery — wash and slice a few for the next couple of days. Snacking shifts when they're ready.

coach.title: Cut a few vegetables ahead
coach.detail: Slice carrots, peppers, celery for the next few days. Visible-ready veg becomes the easy snack.

firm_direct.title: Veg. Cut ahead.
firm_direct.detail: Carrots. Peppers. Celery. Wash, slice, container, fridge. Done in ten.

gentle.title: Cook a little extra protein tonight
gentle.detail: Make a bit more than you need. Tomorrow's lunch is half-built before the day even starts.

coach.title: Cook double protein tonight
coach.detail: Cook roughly twice the protein you need for dinner. Tomorrow's salad or wrap is already half done.

firm_direct.title: Double the protein.
firm_direct.detail: Tonight: cook double. Eat half, save half. Tomorrow's lunch handled.
